/**
 * Not a test: run once on the build live before the fixed daily schedule (pull request #9, 1fab4eb: copy it to
 * tests/unit/zz-live-1018.test.ts there) to write a fixture of the live formats into tests/fixtures/live-2026-10-18/:
 * the settings GitHub Sync writes (state/settings.json, version 3 with Calendar), a day with Block D minutes, and the
 * backup file. Everything is made with that build's own code.
 */
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { it } from 'vitest';
import { loadSeedOrThrow } from '../../scripts/lib/load-seed.ts';
import { splitSeed } from '../../scripts/lib/vite-plugin-seed.ts';
import { db } from '../../src/db/db.ts';
import { createBackup, serialiseBackup } from '../../src/db/backup.ts';
import { updateSettings } from '../../src/db/settings.ts';
import { addEntry, editLog, toggleBlockDone } from '../../src/lib/logs.ts';
import { withScheduleEdit } from '../../src/lib/day-plan.ts';
import { allPaths, readLocal, renderPath } from '../../src/sync/local.ts';

const OUT = join(import.meta.dirname, '..', 'fixtures', 'live-2026-10-18');

function write(rel: string, text: string): void {
  const path = join(OUT, rel);
  mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(path, text);
}

it('writes the live-format fixture of 2026-10-18', async () => {
  const seed = loadSeedOrThrow();
  const { app } = splitSeed(seed);
  await db.open();

  // Settings changed in the app: Core's minutes, the theme, a weekly busy class, a start time on the Full day, a day
  // change for one date (Graphics moved to 19:00), and a schedule edit (so the history keeps a copy of the 8 h day).
  await updateSettings(seed.settings, (s) => ({
    ...s,
    theme: 'dark',
    github: { ...s.github, username: 'octo-learner' },
    core: { ...s.core, blocks: s.core.blocks.map((b) => (b.id === 'C' ? { ...b, minutes: 90 } : b)) },
    schedule: {
      ...s.schedule,
      busy: [{ id: 'uni-tue', title: 'University', start: '10:00', minutes: 180, weekday: 2 }],
      days: { '2026-10-20': { times: { A: '19:00' } } },
    },
  }));
  await updateSettings(seed.settings, (s) =>
    withScheduleEdit(s, '2026-10-17', (x) => ({
      ...x,
      core: { ...x.core, templates: x.core.templates.map((t) => (t.id === 'full' ? { ...t, blocks: t.blocks.map((b) => (b.block === 'A' ? { ...b, start: '07:30' } : b)) } : t)) },
    })),
  );

  // A day with Block D (a project) and Block A, A marked done.
  await editLog('2026-10-17', (l) =>
    toggleBlockDone(addEntry(addEntry(l, { block: 'A', track: 'graphics', minutes: 120 }), { block: 'D', track: 'ai', refId: 'm01', minutes: 95 }), 'A'),
  );

  write('backup.json', serialiseBackup(await createBackup(new Date('2026-10-18T12:00:00Z'))));
  const local = await readLocal(db);
  for (const path of allPaths(local, app)) {
    if (!path.startsWith('state/settings') && !path.startsWith('log/')) continue;
    const text = renderPath(path, local, app);
    if (text !== null) write('atlas-data/' + path, text);
  }
}, 60_000);
